description: A customizable tree item component used to display the item portion of a tree menu. This component supports `start` and `end` slots for custom content at the beginning and end of the item.

properties.name: checkbox
properties.description: If true, renders a checkbox at the start of the tree item.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the li element.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: The disabled state of the tree item.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The text rendered in the tree item.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The selected state of the tree item.

properties.name: focused
properties.description: The focused state of the tree item.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the tree item.

properties.name: subLabel
properties.description: The text rendered beneath the label.

properties.name: tooltipContent
properties.description: The tooltip text to display when hovering over the tree item.

properties.name: tooltipPosition
properties.description: The position of the tooltip relative to the tree item.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The unique identifying value of the tree item.

properties.name: hasSubmenu
properties.description: Whether this tree item has a collapsible submenu. When true, the item will show a caret and handle toggle behavior.

properties.name: blockExpand
properties.description: When true, prevents the built-in inline submenu toggle on click. The item will only emit `itemSelect` so the consumer can handle the expansion externally (e.g. show a flyout panel). Only has an effect when `hasSubmenu` is also true.

events.name: itemSelect
events.description: Event emitted when a tree item is selected.

methods.name: collapseSubmenu
methods.description: Public method to collapse the submenu if it's expanded
